profile.headline: Front-End Web Developer | Shopify & eCommerce Specialist| React, JavaScript, AWS
profile.summary: Detail-oriented professional with a background in operations coordination and client services, now transitioning into software engineering with a strong foundation in full-stack web development. Completed QuickStart’s Software Engineering Program, gaining hands-on experience in front-end and back-end technologies, including; HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Skilled in building responsive web applications, deploying cloud-based solutions, and working in Agile environments. Known for problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Built responsive, accessible websites and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and React.

Integrated APIs, managed state, and deployed projects using AWS.

Applied agile development principles, version control (Git/GitHub), and collaborative coding practices.

Completed multiple individual and team projects from concept through deployment, including an automated JavaScript card game and a responsive eCommerce storefront.

positions.title: Dispatcher
positions.description:
•	Coordinated vehicle pickups and deliveries between auctions, dealerships, and carriers across the U.S.
	•	Scheduled and dispatched drivers to ensure timely and efficient transport operations.
	•	Maintained clear communication with drivers to provide updates and resolve any issues.
	•	Utilized dispatch software to track shipments and update delivery statuses.
	•	Collaborated with clients to confirm transport details and address inquiries.
	•	Ensured compliance with transportation regulations and company policies.

positions.title: Business Services Consultant
positions.description: Partnered with local businesses to implement workforce programs such as internships and on-the-job training. Provided consultation on workforce retention and development strategies. Served as liaison between employers, seekers, and community programs to promote local economic growth.

positions.title: Business Solutions Consultant
positions.description:
As a Business Solutions Consultant for Equus at Arizona at Work in Yuma, I connect local businesses with workforce development programs to address their specific needs. My role involves identifying workforce challenges and providing tailored solutions such as internships, on-the-job training, and employment services. I offer expert advice on enhancing employee training and retention strategies to help businesses thrive.

I facilitate the implementation of workforce initiatives, ensuring they meet employer requirements and compliance standards. By acting as a liaison between businesses, job seekers, and community resources, I promote economic growth and employment opportunities in Yuma. I also utilize data and analytics to assess the effectiveness of workforce programs and make informed recommendations for continuous improvement.

Building and maintaining strong relationships with local businesses is a key aspect of my role, ensuring their needs are met and providing ongoing support for their success. My goal is to drive workforce development and contribute to the economic vitality of Yuma.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: Skills: Git · Shopify Plus · Web Design

positions.title: Freelance Developer
positions.description: Built custom Shopify stores, sections, and theme modifications for small businesses across multiple industries. Developed responsive layouts using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to improve storefront usability and conversion flow. Collaborated with clients to gather requirements, translate designs into functional features, and deliver polished, on-brand solutions. Optimized site performance, SEO structure, and product organization to enhance visibility and user experience. Integrated third-party apps, payment systems, and custom schema settings so clients could manage content easily after launch.

positions.title: Dispatcher
positions.description:
Direct the day-to-day route operations
Maintain consistent lines of communication with drivers in the field and clients
Maintain accurate time keeping logs
Manage driver scheduling to ensure routes are timely
Report service issues to upper management
Organize and conduct operations that adhere and promote Ratp Dev's commitment to safe, cost-effective, on-time operating performance.
Provide general information to the public regarding service
Input manifest data and manage payable route hours
Manage social media for our clients
Inspect buses daily for damages
Transfer money to and from the deposit safe as well as logging the time and amount
Schedule drivers when shifts need to be filled
Develop the ADA On Call Schedules

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Owned and operated a local game store and café for seven years. Managed daily operations: inventory, tournaments, marketing, vendor relations, staffing, and customer service. Built a strong community around trading card games, board games, and events. Handled budgeting, bookkeeping, purchasing, and all business logistics. Grew the store through consistent event hosting, partnerships, and community engagement. Successfully sold the business in 2022.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Monitored multiple databases to keep track of all company inventory. Provided onsite training. Increased Sales by 34% over a two year period. Completed all company insurance renewals including property, Workers' Compensation, general liability, and Cargo. As well as manage employee work scheduling and Payroll responsibility.

company.name: The hidden village food and games

positions.title: Security Guard
positions.description:
Monitor 200+ houses to detect and prevent signs of potential threats and ensure security of doors and windows
Inspect and adjust security systems, equipment, or machinery to ensure operational use and to detect evidence of tampering
Train all new security personnel on security standard operating procedures
Maintain daily logs of irregularities such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences
Gate Duty tracking and logging every visitor who enters or leaves the park.

positions.title: Engineer technician
positions.description:
A field tech is a jack of many trades. a long list of tasks would include

Rigging loads to be dropped by parachute
Guarding classified equipment
Chaperoning foreign customers
Programming systems
Data collection and logging
Building and staging test equipment
Retrieving assets from the field
Traveling across country for months on end to support tests
